entities.name: Doug Beyer
entities.description: The column's narrator, a creative designer for Magic: The Gathering at Wizards of the Coast, who recounts his working days.

entities.name: Aaron Forsythe
entities.description: A Wizards colleague who likes the narrator's suggestion and changes a blue sleep spell to reflect it.

entities.name: Brady Dommermuth
entities.description: Creative team manager who drops off a printout of a planeswalker sketch.

entities.name: Jeremy Jarvis
entities.description: Art director who delivers sketches for an upcoming web comic.

entities.name: Richard Whitters
entities.description: The creative team's concept illustrator, who designed the look for a young version of a censored character.

entities.name: Aleksi Briclot
entities.description: Artist whose original piece the young character's look is based on.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: Red-white planeswalker whose ultimate ability the narrator compares to being cut off from his mana.

entities.name: Wizards of the Coast
entities.description: The company that makes Magic: The Gathering, whose office loses power during the column.

entities.name: Seattle
entities.description: The real-world city where the narrator lives and works.

events.summary: Doug rules in his head that a Griffin cannot be a Soldier, then records the verdict in the Multiverse database.
Doug suggests a blue sleep spell should have duration; Aaron Forsythe makes the change.
events.quote: Aaron Forsythe likes the suggestion, and makes a change to reflect the flavor I was hoping for.

events.summary: Doug has an impromptu card design session over lunch with fellow R&D members.
events.quote: My lunch hour gets turned into an impromptu card design session.

events.summary: Brady Dommermuth drops off a printout of a planeswalker sketch for a set a year away, and the team critiques it.
events.quote: It's a sketch of a planeswalker character, done for a set that won't release for over a year

events.summary: Jeremy Jarvis delivers web comic sketches featuring a younger version of a censored character.
events.quote: There's another printout drop-off, this time from art director Jeremy Jarvis .

events.summary: The power goes out at Wizards of the Coast after an accident in Renton.
events.quote: The power goes out at work.

events.summary: Developers play handwritten prototype decks by window light, and one asks whether a Wurm can be a Warrior.
events.quote: "Hey, Doug. Can a Wurm be a Warrior?"

relations.quote: this time from art director Jeremy Jarvis .
